title: Learning Phase & Optimization
objectives: Master the 50 conversions/week rule to stabilize campaign delivery
Identify which edits trigger a Learning Phase reset
Fix 'Learning Limited' status through campaign consolidation

blocks.text: Meta's AI needs data to work its magic. When you feed it enough conversions, your costs drop like a rock!
Whenever you launch or significantly edit an ad set, it enters the 'Learning Phase'. During this time, Meta explores who is most receptive to your ad.

blocks.title: The Golden 50 Rule
items: 1. An ad set needs roughly 50 optimization events per 7 days to exit learning
2. Once exited ('Active'), daily costs stabilize and CPMs drop by 10-15%
3. If an ad set gets fewer than 50 events, it enters 'Learning Limited'

blocks.title: The Apprentice Chef Analogy
blocks.text: If a student chef only bakes 2 cakes a week, they never get consistent. If they bake 50 cakes in a week, they master the recipe! Give Meta enough volume to become an expert.
What Resets Learning: Changing targeting, swapping ad creatives, changing campaign objective, or increasing budget by more than 20% in one go!
How to Fix Learning Limited: Consolidate! Combine 5 tiny ad sets into 1 unified ad set so all budget and conversions pool together to hit the 50 mark.

quiz.q: Approximately how many conversion events within 7 days does an ad set need to exit the Learning Phase?
quiz.explain: Meta's machine learning model requires roughly 50 conversion events in 7 days to calibrate stable bidding.

quiz.q: Which of the following actions WILL trigger a complete Learning Phase reset on an ad set?
options: Changing the audience targeting or adding a brand new creative
Renaming the ad set without changing any settings
Viewing the reporting dashboard on your phone
quiz.explain: Substantial changes to targeting, creative assets, or bid strategy force the algorithm to start learning anew.

quiz.q: What is the best architectural fix if your account has 6 ad sets all stuck in 'Learning Limited'?
options: Consolidate the fragmented ad sets into 1 or 2 robust ad sets to combine budget and conversion volume
Lower the budget on all ad sets to ₹10/day
Change the objective to Brand Awareness
quiz.explain: Consolidation pools budget and signal density, easily surpassing the 50 conversions/week threshold.

quiz.q: True or False: An ad set with 'Learning Limited' status stops delivering completely.
quiz.explain: False. It continues delivering, but costs will be higher and day-to-day performance more volatile.

recap: Aim for ~50 conversions per week per ad set to exit the learning phase.
Avoid making large sudden edits. Consolidate fragmented ad sets to overcome Learning Limited.
